import { createServer, type Server } from "node:http";
import type { HttpAuthority } from "../interfaces/api/dto.ts";
import { createHttpRouter, type HttpRouter } from "../interfaces/http/router.ts";
import { InMemoryStore } from "../infrastructure/persistence/in-memory-store.ts";
import { createDefaultConnectors, type DefaultExternOverrides } from "../infrastructure/connectors/effect-adapters.ts";
import type { OutboundConnectorsPort } from "../application/connectors.ts";
import type { CashFundPurchaseHandler } from "../cash-fund-purchase.port.ts";
import { createCashFundPurchaseController } from "../interfaces/http/cash-fund-purchase.controller.ts";
import type { TaBridgeSettlementHandler } from "../ta-bridge-settlement.port.ts";
import { createTaBridgeSettlementController } from "../interfaces/http/ta-bridge-settlement.controller.ts";

export interface AppHandlers {
  readonly "CashFundPurchase"?: CashFundPurchaseHandler;
  readonly "TaBridgeSettlement"?: TaBridgeSettlementHandler;
}

export interface BootstrapOptions {
  readonly handlers?: AppHandlers;
  readonly externOverrides?: DefaultExternOverrides;
  readonly authority?: HttpAuthority;
  readonly store?: InMemoryStore;
  readonly port?: number;
}

export interface OnionApp {
  readonly router: HttpRouter;
  readonly store: InMemoryStore;
  readonly connectors: OutboundConnectorsPort;
}

export function createApp(options: BootstrapOptions = {}): OnionApp {
  const store = options.store ?? new InMemoryStore();
  const connectors = createDefaultConnectors(store, options.externOverrides ?? {});
  const handlers = options.handlers ?? {};
  const router = createHttpRouter({
    cashFundPurchase: handlers["CashFundPurchase"] ? createCashFundPurchaseController({ handler: handlers["CashFundPurchase"]!, externs: connectors.cashFundPurchaseExterns, effects: connectors.cashFundPurchaseEffects }) : undefined,
    taBridgeSettlement: handlers["TaBridgeSettlement"] ? createTaBridgeSettlementController({ handler: handlers["TaBridgeSettlement"]!, externs: connectors.taBridgeSettlementExterns, effects: connectors.taBridgeSettlementEffects }) : undefined,
  }, options.authority);
  return { router, store, connectors };
}

export function createHttpServer(options: BootstrapOptions = {}): { app: OnionApp; server: Server } {
  const app = createApp(options);
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
    req.on("data", chunk => chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk)));
    req.on("end", () => {
      const url = new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://127.0.0.1");
      const query: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of url.searchParams.entries()) query[k] = v;
      let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      let stateSnapshot: Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
      const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8").trim();
      if (raw) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Record<string, unknown>;
          if (parsed && typeof parsed === "object") {
            if (parsed.stateSnapshot && typeof parsed.stateSnapshot === "object") {
              stateSnapshot = parsed.stateSnapshot as Record<string, unknown>;
            }
            body = parsed;
          }
        } catch {
          res.writeHead(400, { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ ok: false, code: "INVALID_JSON" }));
          return;
        }
      }
      const headers: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(req.headers)) headers[k] = Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v;
      const out = app.router.route({ method: req.method ?? "GET", path: url.pathname, headers, query, body, stateSnapshot });
      res.writeHead(out.status, out.headers);
      res.end(JSON.stringify(out.body));
    });
  });
  return { app, server };
}

export function startServer(options: BootstrapOptions = {}): Server {
  const { server } = createHttpServer(options);
  server.listen(options.port ?? 3000, "127.0.0.1");
  return server;
}
